newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania bourse continues to cool off after rally.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania bourse continues to cool off after rally.

text.p: Lithuania's bourse continued to cool off on Thursday as the market gradually corrected itself after a brief bull run last month that saw shares soar.
The group A index gained slightly, up 24.88 points to 2,699.43, in sleepy trade totalling 1.48 million litas.
Rokiskis cheese was the most active blue-chip stock, rising to 50.00 litas from 49.01 in trade of 297,100 litas.
Banking shares fell further, with turnover registering just under 69,000 litas.
Block trades worth 895,000 litas were also made on Thursday and the secondary T-bill market turned over 8.25 million litas.
